predecessors.name: Holy Roman Empire
predecessors.text: the Nedersticht and the Oversticht (Overijssel, Drenthe and part of Groningen)

ledger.x: 1141: 'Hartbert van Bierum, the Bishop of Utrecht gave Groningen and Drenthe as fiefdoms' to Leffard and Ludolf; their heirs Egbert of Groningen and Rudolf II of Coevorden later fought each other and the bishop's troops.
ledger.cp: Leffard and Ludolf (Groningen and Drenthe fiefs)

ledger.x: 1233: 'Wilbrand's successor Otto III van Holland succeeded in suppressing the rebellion by mustering a large army' after the Friso-Drentic War of 1231-1233, which the Drenths 'initially won'; as penance they had to build the monastery Sancta Maria de Campe near Coevorden.
1528: the enfeoffed lands pass with the principality.
ledger.cp: Leffard and Ludolf (Groningen and Drenthe fiefs)

wars.name: Battle of Ane and the Friso-Drentic War
wars.outcome: The Drenths beat the bishop's army at Ane on 28 July 1227 and killed Otto II of Lippe; Wilbrand van Oldenburg then roused the Frisians against them (Friso-Drentic War 1231-1233, initially won by the Drenths); in 1233 Otto III van Holland suppressed the…

wars.name: Guelders Wars
wars.outcome: The infobox gives the Guelders Wars as 1502-1543; the page gives no course, participants or outcome.

wars.name: Habsburg conquest of the Sticht
wars.outcome: The bishop sold his territories to Charles V in 1527 and 'the Prince-Bishopric of Utrecht was conquered by Habsburg troops in 1528'.

certainty.note: The page names no border; the modern provinces stand for the Nedersticht and Oversticht, and the Groningen part is a circle.
